escalations.summary: The separate v1.0 validation implementation is committed and merged into the isolated Wave 1 candidate; final direct-main integration waits only for its lead-owned JIT gate state to be committed.
The invoker authorized a targeted retry and reset the counter with explicit guidance that profile apply dry-run is part of the repeatable ordered-selector contract.

Session 2 handed off after the release smoke workflow exposed one stale dry-run consumer. A final authorized Luna xhigh repair updated that workflow and its acceptance test; all configured gates passed, and the exact merged main tree passed cargo-ci plus the MCP suite.

After two substantive rework rounds produced a fully tested final commit, the lead Tier 2.5 sweep found one remaining stale neighbouring phrase at docs/reference/storage-format.md:67 ('minimal provenance record'). The invoker selected option 1 and authorized one narrowly targeted Luna xhigh retry.

After two rework rounds, exact cargo-ci passed at abea9028 but code-review found that the first successful apply of two equal contributors records shared ownership only in the later package record; the first record converges only on a second apply. The invoker selected option 1 and authorized one targeted Terra xhigh retry spanning command, initialization, and provenance boundaries without pulling Wave 7's transaction redesign forward.
